title: Velour Transit
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small stereo master; first 64 seconds form the game mix, full single-pass 128-second master forms the station mix; -7 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: This is a continuous excerpt from the MIDDLE of an already-playing full-volume chorus, not a song opening. The first beat and last beat both have complete drums, bass, chords and pitched hook at strong normal level. No gradual energy or volume ramp. Create one ORIGINAL 128-second stereo SYNTHWAVE instrumental for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT constant 113 BPM in 4/4. A clear steady kick on every quarter beat, tight snare on two and four, crisp eighth hats, short percussive synth key on each quarter beat, round analog bass and soft minor-seventh chords remain audible through the final beat. Signature hook: three dry descending synth notes turn sharply upward into one longer answering note, like a U-turn without a tempo change. At 64 seconds keep drums and level fixed, shift bass roots and reverse the melodic contour into a rising three-note call followed by a clipped downward answer. No quiet intro, slow build, half-time switch, filtered outro, fade, silent tail, tempo drift, abrasive distortion, vocals, speech, samples, known melody or imitation of another song.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Create one original SQUARE 1:1 duohertz cover for Velour Transit, an all-ages synthwave rhythm-game track. Original near-black editorial comic-print cut-paper style with warm ivory, electric cyan, coral red and sparse halftone. Keep every named motif element inside the central 55% width and y=25–68% of the square for a narrow 100px mobile crop, with dark lower fifth for the local title overlay. Flat graphic, no realistic scenery, people, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, strobe or copied game art. Main motif: ONE compact angular warm-ivory sound tunnel shaped from exactly THREE nested open V frames, each with a distinct squared gap at its bottom; ONE cyan pulse line enters the outer frame and ONE coral pulse line exits the inner frame, with a tiny yellow diamond at the center. Abstract audio geometry, not a road, railway, building, cassette or screen.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Edit the supplied Velour Transit square cover into a HORIZONTAL roughly 1.9:1 duohertz social card. Preserve three nested open ivory V frames with bottom gaps, one cyan entry pulse, one coral exit pulse and a yellow center diamond. Recompose the complete motif on the RIGHT half over near-black comic-print ink with sparse halftone, leaving calm dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp fully legible English lines at left: 'duohertz' lowercase electric cyan and 'Velour Transit' larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly, no truncation. Purpose-build the wide composition; do not stretch the square. No other text, scenery, people, logo, watermark or copied game art.
